title: Noetherian approximation preserving flatness and geometrically integral fibres
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a finitely presented flat homomorphism of commutative rings whose fibre rings $S\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ are geometrically integral over $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ for every prime $\mathfrak p$ of $R$ [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra] [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] [def-weil-residue-field] [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Then there exist a cocartesian diagram of commutative rings $R_0\to S_0$, $R_0\to R$, $S_0\to S$ with $R_0$ of finite type over $\mathbf Z$, $R_0\to S_0$ of finite type and flat, and every fibre ring $S_0\otimes_{R_0}\kappa(\mathfrak p_0)$, $\mathfrak p_0$ a prime of $R_0$, geometrically integral over $\kappa(\mathfrak p_0)$; the given rings are recovered by $S\cong S_0\otimes_{R_0}R$.
